548e8132d99bdcdc.description:
What are we building?
Hard Rock Digital is focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We’re building a team with a passion for learning, operating, and creating new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about every customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight, and we strive to ensure we’re always acting authentically.
Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as a leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We’re taking that foundation of success into the digital space, ready to join us?
What’s the position?
We’re looking for a Principal Backend Engineer to own technical direction for backend capabilities within the Promos domain, working within our shared service and cloud ecosystem. You will solve complex distributed systems problems, guide the evolution of APIs, events, data, and services, and raise the engineering bar across teams while remaining close to the code.
Working across Product, Mobile, Web, Data, QA, Platform, Security, Compliance, and Operations, you will turn ambiguous needs into durable strategies and guide critical initiatives from discovery through production. Principal level impact means creating clarity beyond one team, developing other engineers, and being accountable for organizational outcomes, not only implementation.
Your responsibilities will include:
Technical strategy and architecture

• 
Own backend technical direction for the assigned product domain, such as Promos, while aligning with shared platform, cloud, data, and service standards.

• 
Partner with Principal and Staff Engineers and teams that own shared capabilities such as identity, payments, compliance, messaging, and platform services, integrating those capabilities while maintaining clear ownership boundaries.

• 
Guide architecture evolution and modernization, balancing product delivery, technical debt, scalability, and platform investment through pragmatic decisions, clear tradeoffs, and measurable outcomes.

• 
Lead major restructuring work through planned iterative delivery: establish the target end state before execution, decompose the initiative into sequenced tickets, surface dependencies and risks, and provide credible delivery dates that are updated as evidence changes.

Promotional and backend capabilities

• 
Build scalable and reliable promotion lifecycle capabilities, including configuration, eligibility, activation, state transitions, rewards, expiration, auditability, idempotency, and recovery.

• 
Partner with Product, Mobile, Web, Back Office, Data, and Operations to define service boundaries, API and event contracts, experimentation, success measures, and operational controls.

• 
Design resilient services for high traffic and transaction volume, using appropriate data consistency, caching, asynchronous processing, rate controls, and graceful degradation strategies.

Execution, quality, and operations

• 
Remain hands on with the hardest problems, turning ambiguity into iterative delivery while delegating effectively and correcting work that is off course or not producing value.

• 
Model and raise a high bar for code review, using reviews to improve correctness, maintainability, shared understanding, and engineer growth, and advance standards for testing, API design, security, observability, performance, CI/CD, controlled rollout, data migration, and production readiness.

• 
Lead diagnosis across services, APIs, databases, caches, queues, and event streams using correlated logs, traces, and metrics, turning incidents into systemic improvements.

AI enabled engineering

• 
Drive responsible adoption of AI assisted development across discovery, implementation, testing, documentation, debugging, and review, measuring improvements to quality, speed, learning, and developer experience.

• 
Identify valuable product and operational uses for AI, assess feasibility and model risk, and establish guardrails for evaluation, confidential data, human accountability, and production safety.

Organizational impact and culture

• 
Act proactively as a trusted technical advisor to Product and Engineering teams, identifying risks and opportunities early and using customer, operational, and market insight to make clear recommendations and drive decisions to closure.

• 
Mentor Senior and Staff Engineers through architectural guidance, reviews, pairing, and reusable knowledge, and contribute technical perspective to senior hiring, capability planning, and career development.

• 
Resolve systemic risks, ownership gaps, and missing capabilities by bringing the right people together, and lead change with calm ownership, constructive conflict, clear commitments, and learning without blame.

Requirements
What are we looking for?
The ideal candidate will have:

• 
Typically 10+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial experience designing and operating distributed backend systems, plus a degree in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent demonstrated experience.

• 
Deep expertise with Java, Spring, and Spring Boot, with a record of establishing patterns and standards adopted by multiple teams.

• 
Strong AWS knowledge and experience building scalable, resilient applications across multiple regions and availability zones.

• 
Expertise with relational data systems such as PostgreSQL or CockroachDB, including schema design, transactions, migrations, indexing, performance, and consistency tradeoffs.

• 
Experience with streaming technologies such as Amazon Kinesis or Kafka and messaging systems such as SQS, RabbitMQ, or ActiveMQ.

• 
Experience designing microservice and service oriented architectures and operating containerized workloads with Docker and Kubernetes.

• 
Strong judgment around high volume systems, concurrency, idempotency, caching, asynchronous workflows, failure recovery, and backward compatible API and event evolution.

• 
Strong engineering judgment across testing, observability, CI/CD, secure development, performance, privacy, and production operations for business critical systems.

• 
Hands on fluency with AI assisted development and a practical understanding of evaluation, hallucination risk, privacy, security, and responsible human review.

• 
A record of shaping technical and product strategy, delivering ambiguous multi team initiatives, communicating clearly with senior stakeholders, and influencing outcomes without relying on formal authority.

Preferred experience:

• 
Experience in sportsbook, casino, online gaming, fintech, banking, or another regulated digital industry.

• 
Experience building promotion, loyalty, offer, reward, experimentation, or customer engagement platforms.

• 
Experience scaling engineering through shared libraries, developer platforms, service templates, internal tooling, or production AI practices.

What’s in it for you?
We offer our employees more than competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

• 
Competitive pay and benefits

• 
Flexible vacation allowance

• 
Flexible work from home or office hours

• 
Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

• 
Opportunity to build products enjoyed by millions as part of a passionate team

Roster of Uniques
We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and we trust and empower our team to own and improve that experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where, regardless of background or beliefs, you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you. Hard Rock Digital is an equal opportunity employer.
Originally posted on Himalayas

Research Analyst – Sell Side | Equity Research

📍 Location: Andheri, Mumbai (Onsite)

💼 Employment Type: Full-Time

🎯 Experience: 5 - 10 Years

⏳ Notice Period: Immediate to Short Notice Preferred

About the Role

We are looking for experienced Research Analysts – Sell Side to join the equity research team. The role involves conducting institutional and retail equity research, financial analysis, sector tracking, investment idea generation, and providing actionable insights to support investment and portfolio decisions.
Candidates with strong retail equity research experience will also be considered.

Key Responsibilities
• Conduct detailed industry, sector, and company-level research using top-down and bottom-up approaches.
• Build and manage large datasets using market and financial information from sources such as Bloomberg, Reuters, and other research platforms.
• Perform comprehensive financial analysis, including ratio analysis, earnings projections, financial modelling, and valuation.
• Develop and present investment theses, recommendations, and actionable investment ideas.
• Track companies, sectors, competitive landscapes, industry trends, growth drivers, and market developments.
• Prepare research reports, investment notes, sector updates, strategy reports, and advisory outputs.
• Contribute to daily, weekly, and monthly research deliverables, including morning notes, con-call updates, sector reports, and strategy reports.
• Provide research inputs to support portfolio construction and investment decision-making.
• Participate in research publications, internal discussions, and interactions with the investment team.
• Continuously monitor earnings, corporate developments, macroeconomic factors, and market trends relevant to assigned sectors.

Preferred Sector Expertise
Candidates should have relevant equity research experience in at least one of the following sectors:
• Automobiles
• Banking / NBFC
• Small & Mid Cap – Hospitality / Pharma preferred
• Capital Goods / Industrials

Key Skills
• Equity Research
• Financial Analysis
• Financial Modelling
• Company Valuation
• Investment Research
• Fundamental Analysis
• Industry & Sector Analysis
• Earnings Estimation & Forecasting
• Investment Thesis Development
• Ratio Analysis
• Market & Competitive Analysis
• Bloomberg / Reuters
• Research Report Writing
• Investment Recommendations
• Portfolio Research Support

Candidate Requirements
• 5–10 years of relevant experience in equity research.
• Current/most recent designation should be Research Analyst.
• Research Associates will be considered only where they have more than 6 years of relevant equity research experience.
• Strong hands-on experience in financial modelling, valuation, earnings analysis, and investment research.
• Demonstrated expertise in one or more of the preferred sectors mentioned above.
• Strong analytical, research, report-writing, and communication skills.
• Ability to convert large volumes of financial and market data into actionable investment insights.

If you have strong sell-side equity research experience and sector expertise in Automobiles, Banking/NBFC, Small/Mid Caps, Hospitality, Pharma, Capital Goods, or Industrials, we would like to hear from you.
